Formally we can calculate the correlation function by using

\big=\frac{ \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} \prod_{i=1}^N dx_i \, x_i x_j \exp\big(-\frac{1}{2} \sum_{i,j=1}^{N} x_i H_{ij}x_j\big)    }{   \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} \prod_{i=1}^N dx_i \exp\big(-\frac{1}{2} \sum_{i,j=1}^{N} x_i H_{ij}x_j\big)   }.
First, I will give a general proof for the expectation value of
\big=C^{-1}\int_{-\infty}^\infty d^Nx\, x_i f(x) \exp\big( -\frac{1}{2} \sum_{j,k=1}^{N} x_j H_{jk} x_k  \big).
We can now use the identity
x_i \exp\big( -\frac{1}{2} \sum_{j,k=1}^{N} x_j H_{jk} x_k  \big)=-\sum_l H^{-1}_{il}\frac{\partial}{\partial x_l} \exp\big( -\frac{1}{2} \sum_{j,k=1}^{N} x_j H_{jk} x_k, \big)
inserting this into the equation above and using integration by parts we obtain
\big= C^{-1} \sum_l H^{-1}_{il} \int_{-\infty}^\infty d^Nx \exp\big( -\frac{1}{2} \sum_{j,k=1}^{N} x_j H_{jk} x_k  \big) \frac{\partial f}{\partial x_l}.
